sources.headline: Mellow west wind today. Same tomorrow.
sources.forecast_text: Hazy skies strong wind is done until the weekend as gradients have weakened overnight. Not much to get winds going today. As smokey haze returns to the gorge by afternoon cancelling the thermal gradient. And wind to maybe 10-15 MPH at best. Picks up late day from Stevenson / Viento through the corridor by evening but no further east. Looks like more of the same tomorrow. With light wind again all day and a late day puff to 15 MPH at best. Stronger west winds return through the weekend with a big day out east on tuesday.

sources.headline: Breezy through Wednesday, high fire danger ahead
sources.forecast_text: One last day of west wind before we tumble into a heat wave. Early wind was 6-10mph at Stevenson and the Rowena zone. In the afternoon, offshore high pressure strengthens, giving a shot at 17-21mph from Stevenson to Doug's with 17-20mph at the Hatch. Red flag warning as high fire danger continues.
